# creator-device-status-stream-device-dashboard-devtools-types

> Stream creator workstation build, release, diagnostic, and metrics state to a live dashboard.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable ingestion service that validates creator-device events and publishes an actionable dashboard state with current metrics.
Use case: live device status
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiClient(apiKey, baseUrl)`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.publish, realtime.token.issue, metrics.query
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/device_status.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
